slots.name: Right
slots.when: The green sheet comes up after a right answer. The most-heard reward sound, and the one every other reward is built from.
slots.want: two bright notes going up, 250–400 ms. Clean, not childish. Try “rising 5 times” to hear how it would climb in a combo.
